intro: One of the most-asked questions for this trip: how do you actually get from Krabi to Phuket? Here are your options compared, with the honest pick for most travelers.

blocks.html: Short answer: Krabi and Phuket are both on the Andaman coast, about 3–4 hours apart overland by minivan or bus, with frequent departures. In high season there are also ferries linking the two via Phi Phi.

blocks.html: To arrive fast and cheap, take a minivan or bus, many with hotel pickup. If you have time and want a change of scene, the high-season ferry via Phi Phi lets you sightsee along the way.

faq.q: How long is Krabi to Phuket?
faq.a: About 3–4 hours overland by minivan or bus, depending on pickups and traffic. The ferry via Phi Phi takes longer but comes with the views.

faq.q: Is there a direct ferry from Krabi to Phuket?
faq.a: Most ferries stop or change at Phi Phi and typically run only in high season when the sea is calm. Off-season, use the overland route, which runs year-round.
